brochures.file: HIS-BR_0126 (AL Hospital Indemnity Select - Hospital Indemnity Select Brochure).pdf

rows.label: Hospital confinement benefit — 1 Day plan (issue ages 18 to 64½)

values.*: {his.ben} for 1 day per hospital confinement or observation stay

rows.note: Brochure: pays a daily benefit if hospitalized for observation or confinement; daily benefit $50 to $10,000, selectable in $50 increments. Under 64½ the only benefit period is 1 Day, so it pays once per confinement (brochure claim example: 3 nights paid the 1 Day benefit once).

rows.label: Hospital confinement benefit — issue ages 64½ to 89

values.*: 3 Days, 6 Days or 10 Days plan; daily benefit $50 to $750

rows.note: Paid per day of confinement up to the plan's number of days. Not available in CA (CA issue ages are 18 to 64½ only).

values.*: After 60 days of being discharged, your benefits will fully restore

rows.label: Short duration hospital stay

values.*: Discharged within 12 and 23 hours (observation or confinement): 1 Day plan pays 25% of the hospital confinement amount; 3, 6 and 10 Days plans pay 100% of the daily benefit amount

rows.note: In SD there is no time restriction — paid while in the Hospital and never admitted, for sickness or injury.

rows.label: Mental health confinement

values.*: $175 per day, up to 7 days per calendar year

rows.note: For a mental or nervous disorder; paid in lieu of the hospital confinement indemnity benefit.

rows.label: Outpatient surgical procedure rider

values.*: {his.outp} per day when a surgical procedure is performed in an ambulatory surgical center or outpatient hospital facility, up to 2 times per calendar year

rows.note: Rider amounts in the brochure: $250, $500, $750, $1,000, $1,250 or $1,500. Not available in CT.

rows.label: Emergency room or urgent care (injury)

values.*: $150 if treated for an Injury in an Emergency Room or an Urgent Care Facility, up to 6 days per calendar year

rows.note: Injury only — the brochure does not pay this for sickness.

values.*: $200 per ground or air ambulance ride to or from a medical facility, up to 4 times per calendar year, lifetime maximum of 15 trips

rows.label: Skilled Nursing Facility rider (not available under age 40)

values.*: Option 1: $100, $150, $200 or $250 per day for days 1 through 50. Option 2: $100, $150, $200 or $250 per day for days 21 through 100

rows.note: Skilled nursing confinement must be within 30 days of a hospital confinement of at least three consecutive days. POP Pro does not quote this rider.

rows.label: First Day Hospital Admission rider (not available under 64½)

values.*: $250, $500 or $750 upon admission to the hospital, up to 6 times per calendar year

rows.note: Paid in addition to the base hospital confinement benefit. POP Pro does not quote this rider.

notes: Brochure: "Benefits available immediately" — it states no waiting period and no pre-existing condition limitation. Full limitations are only at disclosure.manhattanlife.com, not in the brochure.
Brochure: "Guarantee Issued for ages 64½ to 70"; "Available for ages 18-89"; "Guaranteed Renewable for life"; "Rates DO NOT increase as you age".
Individual, Individual & Spouse, Individual + Children and Family rates available.
Benefits are paid directly to the policyholder, regardless of any other insurance.
POP Pro per-stay amounts ($1,000–$10,000) fit only the 1 Day plan (issue ages 18 to 64½). Issue ages 64½ to 89 choose a 3, 6 or 10 Days plan capped at $750 a day.
CA: issue ages 18-64½ only, so only the 1 Day plan; the 3/6/10 Days plans are not available in CA.
CT: the Outpatient Surgical Procedure rider is not available.
HI: spouse or reciprocal beneficiary; NV and OR: spouse or domestic partner.
Policy form AN7003 (and state variations); riders AN7003HA, AN7003OS, AN7003SN.
